tested_scope.reason: Official Vercel material establishes disqualifying account/auth, finite-credit, and paid-usage conditions before any live request; creating an account/key or consuming credits would violate this role's gates.

provenance.claim: Vercel states free trial access requires signing up for a Vercel account and provides $5 of credits every 30 days; tokens are priced at upstream-provider list price.
Vercel states AI Gateway uses pre-purchased credits by default and usage is drawn down per request; provider token pricing applies with no platform markup.
Vercel's API instructions require creating an API key and setting AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY for authenticated requests.

public_primary_sources_only.basis: Only vercel.com primary-source material was used.

account_auth_or_work_required.basis: Usable API access requires a Vercel account/API key; account creation is prohibited for this role.

finite_quota.basis: The free allowance is finite: $5 of credits every 30 days for free users.

cost.basis: Gateway usage is billed at provider token list prices and draws down prepaid/free credits per request.

work_or_account_creation.basis: Prohibited; no signup, API-key creation, dashboard action, or authenticated request was performed.

continuation.action: Audit aimlapi next using public primary sources and the same zero-account, zero-finite-quota, and zero-cost gates.
